Vendored, unmodified copy of llm-retry's single header, used by the AI chat
sidebar (src/ai/AiProvider.cpp) to decide which HTTP failures to retry and
how long to back off before each retry.

Source:  https://github.com/Mattbusel/llm-retry
Version: 0.3.0 (tag v0.3.0)
File:    include/llm_retry.hpp
License: MIT, see LICENSE.txt in this directory.

Do not hand-edit llm_retry.hpp; replace it wholesale with a newer release's
include/llm_retry.hpp if an upgrade is needed.
